rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Chief Cabinet Secretary's press record of the morning of 26 September 2007 says that the Imperial appointment ceremony and the attestation (親任式及び認証式) took place at the Palace from 08:30 that day, followed by the first cabinet meeting at the Prime Minister's Office, at which the 内閣総理大臣談話 was decided and 福田総理 spoke on political funds.

locator.section: 平成１９年９月２６日（水）午前 — ○初閣議の概要について; ○政治資金のあり方等に関する福田総理の発言について

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same record says the Prime Minister designated in advance, under Cabinet Act art. 9 (内閣法第九条), the order of ministers to act as Prime Minister (臨時代理): first 町村信孝 (Chief Cabinet Secretary), then 高村正彦, 鳩山邦夫, 甘利明 and 額賀福志郎.

locator.section: ○内閣総理大臣の臨時代理について
